description:
Implement pkix-truststore-system with platform-native trust store loading. This is the #1 question from potential adopters. Without it, every consumer writes their own trust anchor loading code or gives up and uses rustls-webpki.

Platforms (priority order):
1. Linux: /etc/ssl/certs, /etc/pki/tls/certs, ca-certificates bundle
2. macOS: Security.framework SecTrustCopyAnchorCertificates
3. Windows: CryptoAPI CertOpenSystemStore + CertEnumCertificatesInStore
4. Android: /system/etc/security/cacerts (post-API-24 also Conscrypt)
5. iOS: SecTrustCopyAnchorCertificates (same API as macOS, different entitlements)

Design: each platform backend is a feature flag. The public API is from_system() -> Result<Vec<TrustAnchor>>. Platform FFI lives in this crate, not in pkix-truststore.

Old tracker: PKIX-8h87.
title: OS trust store integration: pkix-truststore-system
